notes: The byline 'Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith' is a prank name; the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle The Dark as plain text (no player page), as with decks 18479 and 18637.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (5)': Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation, Bespin, Cloud City: West Gallery, The Signal and Beldon's Eye; these count toward the 60. The Signal is not a starting interrupt by its text, so no starting interrupt is set; the strategy says that against a Cloud City deck The Signal and Beldon's Eye are swapped for Heading For The Medical Frigate (also in the list) to pull Squadron Assignments and You've Got A Lot Of Guts Coming Here.
The deck totals 58 as published. The section headers do not match the lists (Characters 21 vs 23 listed, Weapons 5 vs 3, Starships 13 vs 14, Effects 3 vs 4).
Format Premiere - Coruscant: the list uses You've Got A Lot Of Guts Coming Here (Coruscant set).

Posted 'Cloud City Docking Bay 327' dested Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay); 'Cloud City Guest Chambers' dested Cloud City: Guest Quarters; 'Cloud City Upper Plaza Corridor' dested the Light Cloud City: Upper Plaza Corridor.

Posted 'Moving Into Attack Position' dested Moving To Attack Position; 'You Got A Lot Of Guts Coming Here' dested You've Got A Lot Of Guts Coming Here; 'Mirax' dested Mirax Terrik; 'R2-D2 in Red 5' dested Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'Cloud City Technichian' and 'Red Sqaudron 7' are spelling slips.
The post's '?' in place of apostrophes is the DeckTech processor's, as the author says; posted names are kept as shown.
